# Resident native source candidate

The normal source tree and exact Zombies delta reconstruct the source files used by the twice-identical Ubuntu24/GCC13 resident builds. The private retained compiler image and source hashes are pinned in candidate.json and native_profiles/manifest.json.

Actual empty-world room reuse, compatible queue advancement, cancellation and native crash/lost-ack recovery pass on both new binaries. Earlier signed-client normal/Zombies/training/queue proof used the prior GCC15 binaries. Signed-client acceptance of these new bytes, populated recovery, the complete paired backend/client release, mixed-version refusal, rollback and human acceptance remain required. This source candidate selects no production package and authorizes no restart or publication.

Trusted resident slot configuration uses SOURCE-RECEIPT.json resident_contract_profile_sha256, checked against the compiled profile header. This stable contract identity is separate from the current code/source-manifest hashes and exact native binary hash.

Consolidation note (2026-10-29): these receipts describe the original frozen resident profiles, not the later all-branch main build. Main advertises `unqualified` with an empty contract digest and quarantines an explicit resident boot before allocation. Empty boot remains disabled. Reproduce the frozen source from retained commit `dbc839ca0e9ed28967f4f933e5c55cb7ea96ac31` before running its profile materializer; the materializer intentionally rejects current-main source drift. No qualification of the consolidated executable is claimed.
